tactics:
induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.filterMap_cons, List.foldrM_cons]
    cases h : f a <;> simp [h, ih]

induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih =>
    rw [List.filterMap_cons, List.foldrM_cons, ← ih]
    cases f a <;> simp
induction l <;> simp_all [List.filterMap_cons, List.foldrM_cons] <;> cases f _ <;> simp_all
